On the second day of the WN Yerevan ’26 lecture, a separate ticket for attendees appeared
Published by
admin
Tags:
WN Yerevan’26
,
wnconf
It provides access
only to the lectures
on October 16 — the second day of the
WN Yerevan’26
. The cost is approximately 12,200 drams (30 dollars). The schedule includes lectures on game creation using the “Lord of the Rings” and Warhammer 40,000 franchises.
The lectures will take place on Friday from 12:00 PM to 4:30 PM local time at The Alexander hotel in Yerevan.
Let’s highlight a few presentations:
Maksim Ostanin from Saber Interactive will examine how to use achievements to guide players, introduce them to content, and create memorable moments, using Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 as an example.
Polina Dadabaeva from Sakura Games will share her four years of art production experience on The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria. She will discuss which techniques helped speed up the work and which did not prove effective.
Alina Stepanova from Playkot will demonstrate how a closed Discord community and targeted playtests helped the team gather feedback that can be used in game development.
The program also includes talks from specialists from companies such as Sperasoft, Nekki, Perelesoq, Sakura Games, and Unigine.
Just to reiterate: the ticket for attendees includes only the lectures on October 16. It
does not include
the first day of the event, expo and networking zones, the WN Hub online meeting system, lunch, or the party.
The ticket is available
exclusively
to professionals working on games and is not available to service companies or for business development purposes.
To view the program and purchase the Day 2 Lecture Pass, visit the
WN Yerevan’26 website
.
